note_hi: Doodh mein 1 chammach nimbu ras milakar 10 minute rakhein, dahi ki jagah daalein.
note_en: Stir 1 tsp lemon juice into the milk, rest 10 minutes and use instead of curd.

note_hi: Tofu ko paneer jaise tukdon mein kaatein; aakhri 2 minute mein daalein.
note_en: Cube the tofu like paneer and add it in the last 2 minutes.

note_hi: Moongphali ki jagah kaju (tree nut: allergy wale ke liye nahi).
note_en: Cashews instead of peanuts (a tree nut: dropped for anyone allergic).

note_hi: Pyaaz ke bina bhi ban jayega; tadke mein chutki bhar hing daal dein.
note_en: Works without onion; add a pinch of hing to the tempering.

note_hi: Lahsun ki jagah chutki bhar hing, tadke mein.
note_en: A pinch of hing in the tempering instead of garlic.

note_hi: Ghee ki jagah utna hi tel.
note_en: The same amount of oil instead of ghee.

note_hi: Maida ki jagah gehun ka aata; aata thoda naram gundhein.
note_en: Whole-wheat atta instead of maida; knead a little softer.

note_hi: Basmati nahi to koi bhi chawal chalega.
note_en: Any rice works instead of basmati.

note_hi: Sooji ki jagah poha (dhokar); pakne ka samay kam.
note_en: Rinsed poha instead of sooji; it cooks faster.

note_hi: Hari mirch ki jagah aadhi chammach laal mirch powder.
note_en: Half a teaspoon of red chilli powder instead of green chillies.

note_hi: Tamatar ki khatas ke liye 1 chammach amchur.
note_en: 1 tsp amchur for the sourness of tomatoes.

note_hi: Tamatar ki jagah thodi imli ka paani.
note_en: A little tamarind water instead of tomatoes.

note_hi: Malai ki jagah doodh, dheemi aanch par gaadha karein.
note_en: Milk instead of cream, reduced on a low flame.
